text_block_list.text:
In a sudden turn of events, Umamusume
from
around the world will be arriving
for an
impromptu cultural exchange
festival.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm hurriedly preparing for the occasion,
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
One, two, three... That should be
enough flags.
Place the campus map
directly by the entrance,
and make sure
it is readily visible to the crowds!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
The welcome gate is the face of the
school! I
expect all of your work to be
carried out with
pride.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув has such a dignified air to
her...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
She's always so calm and collected, her

instructions always so clear and precise...
She
amazes me.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
You there! Who said there wasn't work
to be
done? I want you both to take
care of putting up
some extra balloons.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Cultural exchange fosters the perfect

environment to learn about each other's
best
qualities—as well as how to improve
on them.
Keep that in mind.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Understood!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: There you are, Эйр Грув!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Scarlet? Did you run
all the
way here?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, there's something I need to
urgently
discuss with you. Um... Rats, it's
on the tip of my
tongue!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! I wanted to ask about
the
trophies for the special exhibit—the
one set to be
held on the pathway to
the field.
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
That has already been discussed by the
student
council. Simply follow the list
and arrange the
designated trophies.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Okay, but the flower arrangements we
ordered
for the guest's seating area also
won't be
delivered in time!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
That won't pose an issue. I've been
growing moth
orchids at a nearby
greenhouse ahead of time.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
They should be just about ready.
Arrange for you
and some others to
bring a few pots over.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'll get to that right
now!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Just one moment, Scarlet.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Wha?! Y-yes?
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув stops Дайва Скарлет in her
tracks. She
begins to comb through her
hair with her fingers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Your hair is all disheveled. That won't
do.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I presume you've been cajoled into
taking all
sorts of jobs, big or small.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard. I'll join you
later to
lend a hand.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! That means a lot to
me!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув's kind consideration appears
to calm
Дайва Скарлет down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
